payload.description: Lets your Agents create images on your own PC with ComfyUI, with no cloud and no per-image fee. Runs ComfyUI, a popular local image generator, behind the scenes so your Agents can turn a description into a picture. Everything is made on your own graphics card. It needs an NVIDIA GPU and a large one-time download of about 21 GB of image models. It comes with one ready-made image workflow.
